title: Water receipt
description: One record per gateway request, produced by gateway/ and displayed by the dashboard. Water is always an estimated range; token and cache fields are measured.

virtual_key.description: From the x-bf-vk or x-dropwise-key header; "default" when neither is sent.

routed_to.description: Model that actually served the request, or "cache" on a cache hit.

region.description: Provider region, or "unknown" when the provider doesn't disclose it (US averages are then assumed, as `method` says).

tokens_estimated.description: True when the provider sent no usage and tokens were approximated as characters / 4.

water_ml.description: Estimated range in `scope`; null when the registry was unreachable.

water_ml_by_scope.description: Both scopes, so the dashboard's what-is-counted toggle needs no second request.

factor_versions.description: factor_id@version_hash for every registry entry used in the estimate (empty on a cache hit).

cache.description: bypass: time-sensitive prompt (or no classifier), cache skipped on purpose. skipped: not cacheable (streaming or tools).

route.description: The classifier's decision; null when it was unreachable (see route_note).

tokens_saved.description: On a cache hit, the tokens the original answer used.

avoided_ml_by_scope.description: On a cache hit, the estimated water the skipped model call would have used.

gateway.description: Time spent in Dropwise itself, excluding the upstream model call.

deferred.description: Present when the request was sent with x-dropwise-defer and ran later, at a lower-impact hour (time shifting). The water estimate does not change with the hour (the registry has no hourly factor), so no water saving from shifting is ever claimed; the profile's index records why the hour was chosen.

run_early.description: True when an operator ran it before its scheduled hour.

illustrative.description: True when the hourly numbers are an illustration, not a measurement.

relative_index.description: The hourly profile's relative index (1.0 is an average hour, lower is better) when the request arrived and at the scheduled hour. Not a water figure.

used_pct.description: High end of used_ml as a percentage of limit_ml.

prompt_preview.description: First characters of the last user message (PROMPT_PREVIEW_CHARS; 0 turns it off).
